answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 147227 Country: india Title: Baby girl name Question: My baby girl was born 25 Nov day Jumuah. Please suggest some name for her my wife name is Sumayya and my name is Abdul Jabbar. Answer ID: 147227 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 358/307/SD=5/1438) You should choose any of the names of Sahabiyat, such as, Aisha, Fatimah, Zainab, Maria, Umaimah etc. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
